name: Dark Power
text: On an arcane attack roll this model rolls one extra die, then sets aside its lowest die.
verify: Core: the attack roll sets its lowest die aside (flags.dropLowestAtk).

name: Dark Power (damage)
text: On an arcane damage roll this model rolls one extra die, then sets aside its lowest die.

name: Field Marshal [Prowl]
text: Warbeasts of this model's battlegroup have Prowl.

name: Vital Magic
text: When a rule would end one of this model's upkeep spells, she may keep it alive by taking d3 damage for that spell.
verify: Core: spells.forceExpire keeps an upkeep a forced expiry (Banishing Ward) would end, for d3 damage, while the caster has more than 6 boxes left.

name: Wraithbane Weapons
text: While the Wraithbane animus is on this model, its attacks ignore bonuses that spells give to the target's DEF and ARM.

name: Controlled Warping
text: At the start of its activation this model picks one warp for the round: Ghostly, Spell Ward or Warp Strength. A frenzied model must take Warp Strength.
verify: RULING: the pick is automatic (Warp Strength) at activation.start; there is no choice decision for it yet.

name: Warp: Ghostly
text: This round the model moves through terrain, obstructions and models it can clear completely, with no penalty.
verify: Core: MoverInfo.ghostly passes through bases, obstructions and rough ground (same as Incorporeal).

name: Warp: Spell Ward
text: This round spells cannot target the model.
verify: Core: castSpell and the spell attack refuse targets an effect wards (forbid beTargetedBySpell; Banishing Ward uses beTargeted against enemy casters).

name: Warp: Strength
text: This round the model's melee damage rolls get +2.

name: Regeneration [d3]
text: Once per activation, unless it ran, this model can be forced to heal d3 damage.

name: Body Snatcher: Heart Eater
text: When this model destroys a living or undead enemy model with a melee attack, it takes that model's corpse token, up to three.
verify: Implemented as an attack plugin (cir.body-snatcher): death.destroyed is not dispatched to data yet.

name: Blood Rage
text: In its Combat Action this model may spend corpse tokens; each one buys one extra melee attack.
verify: Core: x.extraMelee adds the bought attacks to the melee weapon when melee is chosen or while attacking.

name: Meat for the Beast
text: This model may spend a corpse token to boost an attack roll.
verify: RULING: spent automatically when the unboosted hit chance is under 70 percent, because mandatory windows cannot ask the player.

name: Meat for the Beast (damage)
text: This model may spend a corpse token to boost a damage roll.
verify: RULING: spent automatically on a direct damage roll when a token is held.

name: Death Feast
text: At the start of its activation this model may spend corpse tokens; each heals d3 damage.
verify: RULING: tokens are spent automatically while the model is damaged, one per d3.

name: Death-Powered
text: For each corpse token this model holds it has +1 ARM and +1 melee damage.
verify: Damage is a plugin; statOf adds deathPoweredArm() to ARM.

name: Rapid Healing
text: Right after an enemy attack damages this model, it heals d3.
verify: RULING: a hit counts as damage only when the model has damage marked afterwards.

name: Treewalker
text: Forests do not block this model's line of sight, and while it is completely inside a forest it gets +2 DEF against melee attacks.
verify: Core: los options ignoreForest and statOf adds treewalkerDefBonus().

name: From Beneath
text: This attack ignores cover and concealment.
verify: Core: measure() reads ignore cover and concealment from the weapon abilities.

name: Critical Consume
text: A critical hit on a small-based model that is not a Leader removes it from play.

name: Shadow Bind
text: A model hit by this attack gets -3 DEF and cannot advance for a round. It can shake the effect.
verify: Core: applyCondition shadowBind makes a one-round shakeable effect; statOf gives -3 DEF and MoverInfo.noAdvance blocks Normal Movement.

name: Brutal Charge
text: Damage rolls of a charge attack with this weapon get +2.

name: Shifter
text: When this attack hits, the attacker is placed base to base with the model it hit.

name: Blood Reaper
text: This model's initial attack with this weapon hits every model in its melee range and line of sight at once.
verify: Core: declareAttack sets flags.multi for the initial attack; measure rolls against every model in reach and LOS.

name: Grievous Wounds
text: A direct hit takes away Tough and stops all healing on the model for a round.
verify: Core: healDamage and rollTough honour effects that forbid heal or tough.
